summary: Opposition to limiting or sunsetting E-Rate program due to budgetary concerns and the importance of internet access for education in rural areas.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate subsidies, local leaders would face unsustainable budget burdens
claims.evidence_quote: If the FCC cuts or restricts E-Rate funding, local leaders will face an unsustainable burden. Rural districts operate on tight budgets with limited tax bases to draw from. Without E-Rate subsidies, local leadership would be forced to make impossible choices: diverting critical funds away from instructional programs and staffing, or risking severe cutbacks to student digital resources and connectivity.
